answer_1.quote: We focus on two different document grounded generation tasks: (1) Wikipedia Update Generation task and (2) Dialogue response generation.
answer_1.outputs: generated text grounded in a document and coherent with a context

answer_2.quote: Following prior work, we evaluate our system-generated sentences against the reference sentences on Rouge-L, BLEU and METEOR metrics.

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation was conducted on Amazon Mechanical Turk.
answer_4.guideline: Pick the option which is closest in meaning with the reference option. Pick the option which contains information from the document and fits the dialogue context coherently. Evaluate fluency on a scale of 1 (unreadable) to 4 (perfect).
